name: pi
notes: Paths verified against pi's own documentation (skills.md, configuration.md, prompt-templates.md) and the pi-mcp-adapter README. Skills are DECLARED AS A LINK rather than copied: pi documents ~/.agents/skills/ as a natively supported location, and sharing it by symlink gives pi the source's skills with no duplication and no drift to reconcile. The rules document goes to ~/AGENTS.md rather than ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md because pi loads context files from both the agent directory and the working-directory chain, so a second copy under ~/.pi would make the model read the same rules twice.

managed.note: declared link: ~/.agents/skills should already be a symlink to ~/.claude/skills. pi's docs support ~/.agents/skills natively, so this path is shared rather than copied: changes in the source are visible immediately, nothing is duplicated, and there is no drift to reconcile. If you would rather the bridge own a real copy, change mode to copy-tree (then the link must be removed first — the planner refuses to write through one).
pi exposes prompt templates as /<filename> commands
home-level context file; avoids a second copy under .pi/agent that pi would also load

gates.mount_hint: pi loads ~/.pi/agent/extensions/*.ts and subdirectories containing index.ts or index.js, so no manual mount is needed
